requirements.text: Manages and refines the backlog for a mobile payments squad.
Writes user stories and acceptance criteria that incorporate compliance requirements.
Shows a measured improvement in a payments journey funnel against a defined baseline period.
Runs sprint reviews and usability sessions with customers or members.
Has worked with confirmation-of-payee or an equivalent name-checking service, including the handling of close-match results.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Product Owner, Mobile Payments

## Experience

- Managed the backlog for the payments squad of Thistle Credit Union's mobile app, refining stories each week with the four engineers and the tester.
- Wrote the user stories for the new add-payee journey with the compliance officer, including acceptance criteria for the warning shown when a payee name does not match the account.
- After the add-payee journey was rebuilt, the share of add-payee attempts abandoned before confirmation fell from 23.5% (January to March 2024) to 12.9% (May to July 2024), measured with the analytics events defined in the tracking plan.
- Ran fortnightly sprint reviews and three moderated usability sessions with members recruited through the member panel.
- Worked with the integration partner to connect the name-checking service and to test its match and no-match responses before the April 2024 release.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the add-payee funnel report from the app analytics tool, showing weekly abandonment from January to July 2024 with the April release marked, the event definitions from the tracking plan and the period averages of 23.5% before and 12.9% after the release.
